items.title: Ambassadors of AlUla Program Trains 50 Participants in Public Speaking - وكالة الأنباء السعودية
items.raw_summary: AlUla, October 31, 2026, SPA -- The Kefaa Youth Development Association in AlUla launched yesterday the Ambassadors of AlUla × Saudi Speakers program, bringing together 50 young men and women from the local community to develop public speaking and presentation skills aimed at showcasing the governorate's assets globally. The five-day program is conducted by specialized experts and covers key areas including personal branding, digital presence, vocal delivery, public speaking techniques, and narrative storytelling. It also features practical exercises tailored to engaging diverse audiences through AlUla's cultural and tourism heritage. The initiative seeks to cultivate local talent in event hosting, presentation, and promotional content creation, preparing participants to represent AlUla at domestic and international forums and engage effectively with global visitors. Delivered in collaboration with training, community, and media partners, the program supports AlUla's expanding role as a premier destination for global events, conferences, and heritage tourism. -- SPA 08:17 Local Time 05:17 GMT 0014
